content.title: Differential Transmutations and First-Passage Expansions for Monomial Brownian Boundaries
content.abstract: Let $P_t=\exp(t\partial_x^2/2)$ be the heat semigroup and let $F(t)=ρt^p$, where $p\ge2$ is an integer. Previous transported-zero theory associates with this boundary a constant-flux solution annihilated by a polynomial-coefficient differential operator of order $2p-1$. We show that the same differential structure contains the complete formal perturbation expansion of the Brownian first-passage density to $F$. For $N=2p-1$ we construct graded spatial operators \[ \mathcal A_r^{(p)}x^n= \frac{(-1)^r}{r!} \frac{\prod_{j=0}^{pr-1}(n+2j+1)} {\prod_{j=1}^{Nr}(n+j)}x^{n+Nr} \] and prove the Laplace
